data.body: RP-03 retry-budget research checkpoint: compared current Rebar attempt/sleep behavior and the hidden DC retry multiplication probe with Atlassian Cloud guidance, GitLab Jira Connect, Sentry, controller-runtime, Crossplane, ADR 0087, and ADR 0084. Proposed for approval: 3 physical attempts total plus 15 seconds cumulative sleep per logical operation; positive Retry-After remains a lower bound and causes retry_not_before deferral when it cannot fit; one immediate core observe/replan cycle may occur for uncertainty/conflict/drift but shares the same budget. Detailed pending-decision note is in .joe-janitor/rp03-jira-failure-taxonomy.md and durable detail is on rubellite-secondary-cub. RP-04 state was not touched.
